title: The Slot That Ran Inside Itself: processEvents in a Handler, Nested Calls and a Variable That Changed Under Its Owner
fallback: This lesson is about what happens when a Qt handler runs the event loop from inside itself, so it needs Qt. Lesson 07-13 and lesson 07-14 are about work that must wait for or be told to stop by other work, without a loop that dispatches events. Without Qt, do those and come back when Qt is installed.

artifact.note: a handler that is not entered again while it is running: later events wait their turn and are handled in order
